name: Nuisance-Tangent Orthogonal Fusion (doc 22 s3; P1 first new mainline) - R0 normal-only mechanism gate
purpose: Test whether illumination-induced feature drift on NORMAL images can be estimated as a local nuisance tangent from paired interventions on the normal support, and whether scoring only the tangent-ORTHOGONAL residual suppresses normal-image false positives under held-out illumination while preserving synthetic structure defects. Purely normal-only mechanism gate: no real defect tuning, no MVTec AD 2.
context: CECW archived (coupling carried no information) -> doc 22 s10/s13: CECW no-info => start NTOF. GPU: RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB (frozen-backbone feature export).
scope: MPDD development seed0, categories all 6. R0 uses NORMAL images only (train/good support + test/good holdout). Existing A1 fused reference banks (outputs/dynamic_fusion/v3_direction_a/features_*_s0_k{shot}) define the memory; shot runs {1,2,4} for rank-stability, primary R0 reads use shot 1.

interventions.note: 5 families x 3 strengths each = 15 paired variants per image; each variant applied to the SAME image to form a finite-difference pair f_e(T_j(x)) - f_e(x). One extra strength per family is RESERVED as held-out (never used to fit the tangent), giving the holdout pool for the FP-reduction gate.
interventions.visibility_note: strength magnitudes are fixed a priori in normal-visibility range on the category's normal images; NO adjustment against real bad images.

method.pipeline: 1) export per-encoder (DINOv2-B14 grid, AnomalyCLIP image tower aligned grid) patch features for each normal image and all 15 paired intervention variants; 2) per encoder e and per category pool finite differences V_e = [f_e(T_j(x))-f_e(x)] over support images r and variants j; 3) U_e = orthonormal top-r basis (r in {2,3,4}) of pooled V_e (right singular vectors), per category per encoder; 4) query patch deviation d_e = q_e - n_e (n_e = nearest normal patch in the frozen fused/1-branch memory under the SAME protocol as A1); 5) anomaly score = ||(I - U_e U_e^T) d_e|| fused across encoders by joint agreement; A1 raw distance kept as fallback comparator.
method.fusion_rule: score_pixel = 0.5*||(I-U_D U_D^T) d_D|| + 0.5*||(I-U_C U_C^T) d_C|| evaluated on the A1 protocol 56x56 grid after dists2map; report DINO-only, CLIP-only, and simple concat-projection versions as mandatory controls.
method.note_patch_level: R0 uses per-category pooled tangent (one U_e per category per encoder). A per-patch local tangent is a documented later refinement and is NOT required by the R0 gate.

r0_gates.g1_fp_reduction: median over held-out illumination images of FP_NTOF(H)/FP_A1(H) <= 0.75 (>=25% reduction), where FP = #pixels above the category's normal 95th-percentile threshold computed on ORIGINAL good images with each method's own scores (normal-only calibration, no GT).
r0_gates.g2_defect_preservation: median over synthetic defects of mean score_NTOF(defect cells)/mean score_A1(defect cells) >= 0.90 for each of cutpaste / local_erasure / thin_scratch.
r0_gates.g3_controls: random orthonormal subspace (same rank), wrong-category tangent, and shuffled intervention pairing must each be worse than the true tangent by >= 0.05 in normalized FP-reduction effect (effect=(FP_A1-FP_NTOF)/FP_A1 on the g1 holdout set).
r0_gates.g4_rank_stability: conclusions of g1-g3 must be directionally stable across r in {2,3,4}; no rank chosen by looking at real bad images.
r0_gates.g5_encoder_controls: DINO-only, CLIP-only, and simple concat projection versions are reported; NTOF must not be worse than its best single-encoder control by more than 0.01 in FP-reduction effect.
r0_gates.stop_rule: If g2 synthetic preservation < 0.90 fails, stop immediately WITHOUT tuning intervention ranges on real defects (doc 22 s3.6). Fail of g1/g3 archives NTOF and moves to PRS (doc 22 s10/s13).

leakage.calibration: thresholds and tangent fits use only NORMAL images (support train/good + original test/good).
leakage.heldout: held-out illumination strengths are never used to fit U_e.
leakage.evaluator: no GT, no bad images in R0.
leakage.tuning_ban: no search on real defects; no MVTec AD 2 download/label look-up until a frozen winner exists.

r1_future: Only if R0 gates pass: MPDD seeds {0,1,2} x shot {1,2,4} full real-defect gates (doc 22 s3.5).
